        - heading "Understand Informal Limits" [level=2]
        - paragraph: "An informal limit is the value a function appears to approach as x gets close to a chosen number. In Informal Limits, that statement is the exact rule used on the labelled chart and in the three numerical examples. A useful rule is Limit idea: lim x->a f(x)=L. You can learn Informal Limits by trying one small example instead of long theory."
